allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A mother and daughter move to a new town and find themselves living next door to a house where a young girl murdered her parents. When the daughter befriends the surviving son, she learns the story is far from over.

facts.overview: A mother and daughter move to a new town and find themselves living next door to a house where a young girl murdered her parents. When the daughter befriends the surviving son, she learns the story is far from over.
facts.title: House at the End of the Street

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: A past double murder seemingly tore the family next door apart, but the surviving son's quiet presence suggests the horror never truly ended.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After moving to a new town, a mother and daughter discover their next-door neighbor's home was the site of a brutal double murder. When the daughter befriends the surviving son, a dark history begins to resurface.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, heavy suburban dread with medium pacing that commands engaged, solitary attention.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Mark Tonderai delivers a steady, suspenseful horror-thriller anchored in suburban unease, balancing a heavy family tragedy with tightening psychological dread.
